name: MARTÍN SALINAS SCUSSOLIN

sections.title: SUMMARY
sections.text: Software and cloud engineer shipping end to end, from cloud to mobile; at Mynu I cut cloud costs ~70%.

sections.title: TECHNICAL SKILLS
bullets: **Cloud & Platform:** AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, SQS, S3), Kubernetes (k3s), ArgoCD, Terraform, Grafana.
**Architecture & IAM:** Microservices, event-driven design, distributed systems; Cognito, Clerk, OAuth, JWT.
**Backend & Data:** Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Docker, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
**Agentic Development:** Architecture and review are mine; Claude Code agents handle most implementation.

entries.title: Software Engineer (Cloud & Platform)
bullets: Sole infrastructure engineer: planned and led the ECS/Fargate → Kubernetes (k3s) migration with Terraform and ArgoCD GitOps, cutting monthly cloud costs ~70%; merged three Aurora instances into a single RDS instance.
Built a queue-driven PDF report service for bulk B2B distribution (~150 queued reports tested with real users) and a shared library for genetic-predisposition calculations.
Created the team's Claude Code skills (spec → issue → stacked PRs → automated review), synced org-wide; administer GitHub Enterprise and review team and AI-generated code.
Shipped Mynu App (iOS/Android) and web platforms from zero to production with React Native (Expo) and React; earlier led the Azure → AWS ECS/Fargate migration.
Migrated auth from Cognito to Clerk with zero downtime or data loss.

entries.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built customer mobile-app features, revamped the internal task-management platform and upgraded the QA platform.

entries.title: Junior Cybersecurity Engineer (Intern)
bullets: Assessed clients' Azure networks; drafted security docs and Cyber Kill Chain action guides; researched ISO 27001.

entries.title: Operations Engineer (Intern)
bullets: Supported hosting infrastructure and GLPI ticketing; monitored systems with Cacti; contributed to internal SLA policy.

sections.title: KEY PROJECTS
bullets: **[Trismegistus](https://github.com/xMuramasa/hermes-relay):** Go WebSocket relay and native SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose apps for a self-hosted AI agent.
**[Caduceus](https://github.com/xMuramasa/caduceus):** Go engine of my agentic workflow: issue → headless Claude Code run → gated merge queue.
**Self-Hosted Homelab:** 25 Docker Compose containers behind Caddy (wildcard TLS), Tailscale, restic backups.
